purpose: Structured target-language family-member profiles for current Tier 1 and Tier 2 learnable languages. Relationship facts are independent from the learner's explanation language so arbitrary source/target pairs do not require pair-specific lesson files.

record_contract.target_explainer_en: Canonical English editorial explanation of the target language's kinship pattern. Other source-language renderings localize the structured facts without changing them.
record_contract.distinctions: Dimensions that materially affect beginner word choice. Absence is not a claim that the language can never express the distinction.
record_contract.core_terms: Representative relationship-aware beginner terms. Broad English glosses must not erase target-language distinctions or collisions.
record_contract.cultural_note_en: Usage/culture caution. Do not turn community tendencies into claims about every family or speaker.
record_contract.examples: Short beginner-safe examples illustrating actual distinctions.
record_contract.source_refs: Research provenance. Trust state must reflect the level of verification.

research_baseline.principle: Model kin relationships independently of English labels. Multiple forms and multiple kin types may map across one broad English gloss. Missing data is not evidence of a lexical gap.
